The parameter names Aligned and Dma sit next to the values, so the rule and the PR 4901 precedent (d0e6f816dd) call for the bare literal; the constants stay because kv_cache.hpp:2556 and the tests use them as use-site template arguments.

**[named bool] bare true/false as a template argument**

The first template argument of make_llm_executor is the bool parameter Permuted [h/tron/models/common.hpp:77]. A bare false at the use site does not say that the executor is the unpermuted one. The alias tron::host names this exact instantiation [h/tron/models/common.hpp:100], so `model<llm<llm_config, host>>` is the shorter option with no new constant.

Proposed:
```cpp
// file scope (both test cases use it), directly after `namespace {`:
constexpr bool PERMUTED_FALSE = false;  // make_llm_executor<Permuted, ...>

      model<llm<llm_config, make_llm_executor<PERMUTED_FALSE, tensor, tensor, tensor>>>;
```
